comment: TURN 4 'Punched-Up Realism + The Fade' visual tuning — see design/gdd/art-bible.md. One 0..1 blend crossfades the world from SURVEY (4A) to DEAD FREQUENCY (4B).

post.comment: v5.0 Wet Black cinematic pass — exposure feeds the ACES curve; bloom gain lerps survey->dead by the fade; grade_strength scales the DEAD crush/desat (post_bloom_grade.gdshader)

shadows.comment: 2D shadow casting on the flood cone + explosion lights; filter_smooth = PCF13 smoothing px, color_alpha = how much light a shadow blocks (never fully)

dust.comment: volumetric dust motes — near-invisible at base_alpha, ignite to beam_alpha inside the flood cone; drift_speed in px/s sideways wander
